description: This file defines the 'InstanceIdentity' enum which provides static methods and properties to retrieve device and environment identifiers such as instance ID, device name, model identifier, device family, and platform string. It handles platform-specific code for iOS and macOS, using conditional compilation, and manages user defaults for persisting the instance ID.

methods.description: A helper method to execute a closure on the main actor, handling both calls from main thread and other threads.
